senses.gloss: pr. n. m. (Ocellus?) Onk’los, the alleged translator of the Pentateuch into Chaldaic, freq. surnamed הַגֵּר the proselyte; often identified with Aquila, the alleged author of a Greek translation of the Bible; v. עְקִילָס. Cmp.
units: <cite ref="Megillah 3a:4">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 11a:2">Ab. Zar. 11ᵃ</cite>, with Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:11">Cant. R. to I, 11</cite> <cite ref="A01944"><he>אלקולאון</he></cite> q. v.
